metadata.case_name: BIJAY RAI v. PACIFIC CROWN ENGINEERING LIMITED AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.education_level: educated in Nepal up to Middle 4 level (left school in 1990)

injuries.description: compound fracture over the metaphysial and diaphysial junction of his right tibia and fibula
source: he had a 15 to 20 cm long wound over the anteriomedial aspect of the right leg with active bleeding and a compound fracture over the metaphysial and diaphysial junction of his right tibia and fibula.
an above-knee amputation was performed on 11 November 1996.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between right hip and knee

manifestations.description: eczema and itchiness of the skin over the stump
pain at the stump and groin when he walked with the prosthesis attached
mild tenderness over the tip of the stump
problems in walking up and down stairs and slopes
difficulties in squatting and prolonged standing or walking; could not walk for more than 20 minutes
falls frequently due to instability of prosthesis and uneven surfaces
sleep disturbances (stump pain at night sometimes prevented sleep)
embarrassment and distress because the prosthesis is thinner than his natural leg

treatments_received: Revascularisation with external fixation of the fracture (attempted but unsuccessful)
Rehabilitation (transferred to Pok Oi Hospital on 6 December 1996)
Fitted with a prosthesis (stump of the thigh)
treatments_future: C-Leg computerized prosthetic knee (recommended replacement prosthesis)
Replacement of prosthesis every four to five years (replacement schedule adopted in award)

losses.description: Loss of right leg by above-knee amputation; inability to use an artificial leg satisfactorily and resulting permanent impairment

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Can no longer walk, play football and volleyball; was an active sportsman before the accident
Considerable limitations on mobility; difficulties in walking, climbing stairs and slopes; walks with a limp; cannot walk more than 20 minutes
Embarrassment and distress caused by prosthesis being thinner than natural leg
Wife has left him and there are diminished prospects of remarriage; adverse effect on family life
Very limited prospects of remarrying as a result of injuries and their consequences

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Suffers sexual problems as part of ongoing trauma and medical condition
Can no longer return to pre-accident employment and has not worked since the accident; only fit for sedentary work
